index.title: {{brand}} Insurance | Private-client home insurance for California wildfire country
index.description: A licensed California brokerage for high-value homes. Your dedicated broker shops every market, explains your options in plain English, and shows you how to make your home easier to insure.

how-it-works.title: How it works | {{brand}} Insurance
how-it-works.description: From your address to your options, with a licensed broker at every step. How we build your application, shop every market, and give you a plan for next year.

buying-a-home.title: Home insurance before closing in a wildfire area | {{brand}} Insurance
buying-a-home.description: Your lender needs proof of insurance before you close. We work quietly to your closing date, across standard insurers, the FAIR Plan, and surplus lines.

non-renewed.title: Non-renewed? What to do next | {{brand}} Insurance
non-renewed.description: A non-renewal is stressful, not the end of the road. Send us your notice and your dedicated broker will lay out every option while you still have time.

fair-plan.title: On the California FAIR Plan | {{brand}} Insurance
fair-plan.description: The FAIR Plan mainly covers fire. Your broker reviews your coverage, explains the companion (DIC) policy, and looks for a path back to fuller coverage.

rebuilding.title: Rebuilding after the fires | {{brand}} Insurance
rebuilding.description: If you're rebuilding in the Palisades, Altadena, or Malibu, let's talk about protecting what you're building, during construction and after you move in.

make-your-home-insurable.title: Make your home insurable | {{brand}} Insurance
make-your-home-insurable.description: What insurers look at: roof, vents, the first five feet, defensible space, and hazard zone. Every client gets an insurability report and a hardening plan.

partners.title: For realtors, lenders, and advisors | {{brand}} Insurance
partners.description: Don't let insurance hold up your closing. Refer a client and a licensed broker takes it from there, keeping you posted with your client's permission.

about.title: About | {{brand}} Insurance
about.description: A licensed California brokerage for high-value homes in wildfire country, named for Temescal Canyon in Pacific Palisades.

faq.title: FAQ | {{brand}} Insurance
faq.description: Plain answers about the FAIR Plan, surplus lines, hardening discounts, how we work, and what happens after you request a review.

book-a-call.title: Book a call | {{brand}} Insurance
book-a-call.description: A private 30-minute call with your broker, by phone or video.

request-a-review.title: Request a private review | {{brand}} Insurance
request-a-review.description: Tell us about your home. Your dedicated, licensed broker takes it from there.

legal.title: Licenses and disclosures | {{brand}} Insurance
legal.description: Licensing details, our role as a broker, and the surplus lines disclosure.
